params.negative: worst quality, low quality, score_1, score_2, score_3, artist name

card.architecture: Anima 2B anime base (Qwen3-0.6B encoder, Qwen-Image VAE), whole-image img2img redraw
card.summary: Reinterpret an entire existing image through Anima using a prompt — the source is used as the init latent ('the noise thing') and re-sampled at a partial denoise with NO mask, so the composition is kept but the whole frame is redrawn in Anima's anime style. Ideal for restoring an off-model edit (e.g. a pose produced by another editor) back to the character's clean look.
card.pick_when: You want to redraw the WHOLE image (not a masked region) through Anima, keeping the composition — e.g. converting an off-model pose back to the character's Anima look.

prompt.guidance: Type the FULL prompt for the character/scene; the quality prefix is added automatically. Booru tags, lowercase with spaces; artists prefixed with '@'. Lower the redraw strength (denoise) to stay close to the source composition; raise it to let Anima reinterpret more.
prompt.example: 1girl, solo, brown hair, long hair, standing, @artistname

negative.note: Default: 'worst quality, low quality, score_1, score_2, score_3, artist name'.

ui_help.note: Send an image + a prompt; the whole frame is redrawn through Anima. 'Redraw strength' controls how far it drifts from the source.
ui_help.good_for: restyling / restoring a whole image to Anima's look while keeping its composition

edit_use_cases: whole-image img2img: redraw an entire image through Anima from a prompt, keeping composition (restyle / fix an off-model image)
